jobs.description:
Role description

The Cyber Security Incident Response Team is a centralized security service, responsible for managing cyber security incidents within the Proximus Group. The team is responsible for delivering all relevant services to mitigate an incident as quickly and efficient as possible and to keep (higher) management updated on the progress.

As an Incident Response Specialist in the CSIRT you are responsible to respond to cyber security incidents when they occur. Your main objective is to respond effectively and work together with the technical teams within the different business unit within Proximus.

Role:

• You have end-to-end responsibility for coordination of cyber incidents that are being reported by internal or external sources, including: prioritize incidents, identify key people in system teams, organize crisis meetings, send notification alerts to key stakeholders, perform complex incident analysis, perform forensic investigation where applicable, document analysis findings, perform research on threat actor, share and discuss threat information with team and liaise with press team in case of public exposure.
• You provide expert support to the team that monitors security alerts (Cyber Defence Center).
• You are responsible for collecting and generating statistical incident information, build reporting, regularly present reporting information to higher management.
• You liaise with 3rd parties (other telecom operators, security actors, equipment vendors…) to gather intelligence about emerging threats and vulnerabilities. Take appropriate actions accordingly with relevant teams, in order to limit risk and exposure for Proximus.
• You initiate and participate in expert reviews with engineering and monitoring teams in order to improve security architecture for critical environments, monitoring tools, security processes, cyber defence strategy, etc.
• You proactively propose improvement actions for IT/Network to reduce/prevent cyber incidents, and perform follow-up until implementation.
• You provide input for mitigation plan.

Profile:

• Bachelor’s in Computer science/ Information security or equivalent combination of education and experience.
• CISSP, CISM, CISA, CEH, CHFI certificates are considered high value.
• You have in-depth knowledge of Internet technology and protocols.
• You are an expert in security vulnerabilities/weaknesses and related attacks.
• You have a good knowledge of scripting languages (Perl, PHP, Python, shell…).
• You are flexible and a strong team player.
• You have great communication skills and experience in participating in (inter)national security information sharing groups.
• You show integrity & trust while managing confidential information.
• Experience within telecommunications environment and technologies is considered of high value.
• Mastering English is a must for the position. Speaking French and/or Dutch is a plus.
• You are ready to work and respond to incidents outside of business hours.
 

**Applicants must enjoy full rights as Belgian citizens or have been living for 5 years in Belgium to be considered for this role.**

As a Press Line Machine Operator, you are responsible for operating the equipment on the press line, ensuring that the clay is shaped and compacted to the correct form and density before the bricks enter the kiln.  Your Key Responsibilities:

• Preparing the production line according to the planned production schedule.

• Setting up and changing over the equipment to meet the required specifications.

• Operating the production line and monitoring/adjusting parameters in accordance with established procedures.

• Managing the loading and unloading of the drying chambers.

• Replenishing the hood kiln.

• Monitoring and adjusting the quality of the bricks produced.

• Recording production data and technical observations.

• Carrying out minor maintenance tasks and ensuring a clean and tidy working environment. 

Who Are You?

 

• You have a technical qualification or a strong technical aptitude.

• You have a basic understanding of automated equipment and systems.

• You have several years of experience as a machine operator or in operating more complex equipment, preferably in a production environment.

• You are fluent in Dutch and/or English.

• You are willing to work day shifts, starting at 7:30 a.m.

Responsibilities

• Define and implement the testing strategy for a large-scale merger program.
• Organize and coordinate testing activities across various organizational entities.
• Act as the primary point of contact between business stakeholders, testing teams, and IT departments.
• Manage and maintain testing activities and progress tracking using JIRA.
• Coordinate test planning, execution, and reporting while ensuring follow-up on identified issues.
• Contribute to the preparation and maintenance of the program roadbook in collaboration with project leaders.

Requirements

• 5+ years of experience in project management and software testing leadership.
• 5+ years of expertise in quality assurance and Integration Testing.
• 5+ years of hands-on experience with JIRA for test tracking and coordination.
• 5+ years of experience with Test Automation frameworks and methodologies.
• 3+ years of proficiency in SQL for data validation.
• You bring a proven track record in defining and implementing complex test strategies.
• You have the ability to produce structured documentation and reporting for diverse stakeholders.
• You possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a proactive mindset.
• You are a Native speaker of Dutch and are fluent in French and English.
Nice to Haves

• Previous experience in complex transformation or merger programs.
• Familiarity with infrastructure migration requirements and planning.

We are looking for a technically minded operator who enjoys practical work and wants to learn new things. You will operate and monitor various advanced machines:

Monday - Friday: 08:00 PM - 04:00 AM

• Experience operating Manitou and Komatsu cranes is a plus
• A stable CV

jobs.occupation: Extrusion Operator – 2 Shifts & Permanent Night Shift
jobs.description:
For a company in regio Wielsbeke we are looking for motivated and technically skilled Extrusion Operators to join the production team. We have opportunities available in both a two-shift system (early and late shifts) and a permanent night shift.

As an Extrusion Operator, you will be responsible for operating and monitoring extrusion machinery to ensure efficient production and consistent product quality.

• Monitor product quality and ensure compliance with quality standards.

• Perform routine quality checks and make adjustments when necessary.

• Identify and report machine malfunctions or production issues.

• Carry out basic cleaning and maintenance tasks.

• Follow all health, safety, and production procedures.

• Work closely with colleagues and supervisors to achieve production targets.

 

Your Profile:

• Experience in extrusion or a similar production environment is an advantage.

• Technical understanding and a hands-on approach.

• Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.

• Ability to work independently as well as part of a team.

• Flexible and willing to work either a two-shift system or a permanent night shift.

• Reliable, motivated, and eager to learn.

• You speak English or Dutch fluently.

jobs.occupation: Senior Automation Equipment Engineer | Pharma | Courcelles
jobs.description:
Your Role as a Senior Automation Equipment Engineer

Would you like to play a key role in two strategic automation projects within a high-tech MedTech environment? As a Senior Automation Equipment Engineer, you will be responsible for the technical design, implementation, and handover of advanced automation solutions within a European distribution center.

You will collaborate with Operations, Quality, EHS, OEMs, and system experts to ensure installations operate safely, reliably, and efficiently. From design and specifications to commissioning and operational handover, you will take ownership of the technical equipment. Combining technical expertise with stakeholder management, you will ensure the successful delivery of complex automation projects.

We can count on you for:

 
• Preparing equipment specifications for automation and packaging systems.
 
• Reviewing mechanical, electrical, and PLC/HMI designs.
 
• Defining interfaces between conveyors, packaging machines, and sorting systems.
 
• Leading FAT, SAT, and commissioning activities at supplier sites and on-site.
 
• Conducting machinery risk assessments in collaboration with EHS and OEM partners.
 
• Developing maintenance plans, spare parts strategies, and training programs.
 
• Supporting quality and change control processes within regulated environments.

You are structured, communicate effectively with a wide range of stakeholders, and are confident in challenging technical decisions when needed. Thanks to your analytical mindset, you can tackle complex automation challenges in a pragmatic and goal-oriented way.

Hard Skills

 
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electromechanics, Automation Engineering, or a related field.
 
• Minimum of 8 years of experience in automation or capital equipment engineering.
 
• Hands-on experience with FAT, SAT, installation, commissioning, and equipment handover.
 
• Strong knowledge of machinery safety, CE marking, EN ISO 12100, and EN ISO 13849.
 
• Fluent in English and French.

jobs.occupation: Senior Engineering Project Manager | Pharma | Courcelles
jobs.description:
Your Role as a Senior Engineering Project Manager

As a Senior Engineering Project Manager, you will lead two strategic automation projects within a complex MedTech distribution environment. You will be responsible for overseeing planning, budgets, risks, and vendor performance, while technical experts focus on design, validation, and implementation.

You bring structure to large-scale capital investment projects and ensure all stakeholders remain aligned throughout the project lifecycle. Thanks to your experience with automation and capital projects, you can maintain oversight across multiple workstreams simultaneously. You translate complex project information into clear reporting and support management-level decision-making.

We can count on you for:

 
• Developing and managing integrated project schedules and key milestones.
 
• Monitoring project scope, budgets, forecasts, and risks.
 
• Coordinating OEMs, system integrators, and multidisciplinary stakeholders.
 
• Preparing monthly cost reports and financial analyses.
 
• Managing RAID logs, decision registers, and change control processes.
 
• Preparing steering committee materials and management reports.
 
• Supporting commissioning, go-live activities, and operational handover.

You remain calm in complex project environments and know how to align a wide range of stakeholders around key decisions. You work in a structured manner, are not afraid to escalate issues when necessary, and thrive on creating clarity and control within large-scale investment projects.

Hard Skills

 
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering or another technical discipline.
 
• Minimum of 8 years of experience in project or program management.
 
• Proven experience managing warehouse automation projects with CAPEX budgets exceeding €10 million.
 
• Experience working in regulated environments such as GxP, Pharmaceutical, or MedTech industries.
 
• Strong proficiency in Microsoft Project, Excel, PowerPoint, and Planisware.
 
• Fluent in English; French is considered an asset.

You will be a member of the SEM/TEM team. This team is responsible for in-line and out-of-line released electron microscopy inspection.  As a TEM technician you ensure the smooth processing of the various TEM inspections, focusing on the quality of the inspection. 

As SEM/TEM technician you will have the following key responsibilities: 

• You follow-up the inline TEM queue.
• You adjust released recipes for automated TEM inspections.
• You are responsible for (semi)-automated and guided TEM inspections.
• You contribute to achieving targets.
• You help with statistical process control (SPC) on TEM tools. 

• Preferable you have a bachelor’s degree or associate degree (2-year program) in science (chemistry, biology, physics) or equal to experience.
• It would be a great plus if you have hands-on experience with automated metrology or SEM/TEM inspections in the semi-conductor industry.  
• You are a strong planner and you would enjoy working in a fast-paced environment. You certainly know how to multi-task and prioritize assignments.  
• You are a communicative team player with a very good knowledge of both English and Dutch.
• You are prepared to work in a shift system (early/late/night and 1 weekend out of 4).
